On today's episode, my interview with Congressman Ted Liu shows the tension firsthand. Liu is in a better position to understand AI than most of his colleagues. He's one of the few lawmakers with a computer science degree. From Stanford, no less. But as you'll hear in our interview, there are AI issues where even he is hesitant to take a stance. Because he just doesn't know enough yet. I think maybe the best place to start is this with the bill you proposed earlier this summer that would establish a blue ribbon commission to study AI and advise Congress as it looks to regulate AI. How much traction are you seeing so far among your colleagues with that idea?
